effect_description_eng: [On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 red or yellow card with 2 or more colors and 1 Tamer card with [Yolei Inoue] in its name among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [End of Your Turn] This Digimon and any of your other Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
